requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into a surface threshold because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class preference and the planned student-residence use are not in the reference columns and are not used as filters. The location 'Turin' is a geographic reference handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not set.
User prefers energy class C or better, translated to all classes from A1 down to C.

A university student residence is essentially dependent on nearby schools and universities. The value is set at the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75) to ensure the building sits in a high-access area.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters ESTATES to office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 sqm, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates, energy class A1-A4/B/C, and education score >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the coordinates, nearest first. No LIMIT is applied.
